document_metadata.continuation_note: This file continues the transcription started in ce10_11_lot4_s4-1_pages_1_3_5_6_7.json. Pages 5, 6 and 7 of the source PDF were already transcribed in that file and are not repeated here.

transcription_convention.strikethrough: Text struck through in source is wrapped in ~~double tildes~~. Replacement value (if any) follows immediately after.
transcription_convention.amendment_flag: has_amendment: true means the row is shaded/marked as amended in the addendum.
transcription_convention.verbatim_policy: Spelling errors in source are preserved as-is (e.g., 'QUANITITIES', 'Stater', 'Marshelling', 'ponts', 'tranducers', 'Signailing', 'Inbuild', 'compatability', 'instantanious', 'symetrical').
transcription_convention.empty_quantity_columns: Rows with no quantities in source have quantities: null.
transcription_convention.stamp_number_inference: Stamp numbers were not clearly legible for these pages; they are inferred by extrapolating the pattern observed on previously-transcribed pages (stamp_number = page_number + 194) and should be verified against the original scans.

document_metadata.rate_amount_note: Unlike pages 1-7, several summary/roll-up rows on pages 8-14 (e.g. delivery, installation, testing, interlocking, panel totals) DO carry populated Rate in INR / Amount in INR figures. Individual component sub-items (a, b, c ... under each feeder/starter) remain blank, consistent with earlier pages.

Main Distribution Board (MDB), DB-130 & DB-230 as per M & W Specifications, as per tender drawings Complete & as per following details:
INCOMER

Automatic transfer switch with 2 Nos 1000A, 4 pole, ~~65~~ 50 kA electric drawout (EDO) ACBs, electrically and mechanically interlocked, controller having selector switch for automatic & forced operation on normal and emergency sources, monitoring of normal source and automatic changeover, test facility, circuit breaker status indication (On, Off & Trip), 3 ph Under - voltage protection, Phase Sequence Protection inbuilt in the controller or separately provided, the controller should have communication capability with BMS/SCADA. The ACB complete with safety shutters, 240V AC or 110V DC (control supply voltage to be selected in consultation with BMS Contractor) shunt trip coil & closing coil and having microprocessor based releases with (1) Communication capability (2) Provision for measurement of three phase current (3) Protection against long time + short time + instantanious + earth fault (all with adjustable time delays), Energy metering (4) Zone Selective Interlocking Unit for Total Discrimination (5) Commuto remotely read and set parameters for the protection functions, transmission of ammeter measurements (6) Signailing of the cause of tripping and alarms, maximeter reset etc (7) NO / NC contacts for interlocks and indications (8) 1 no CT in neutral to connect with the trip unit. must have Electronic Trip Unit with Overload & Short Circuit Protection, closing & shunt trip coil, auxiliary contacts for ON, OFF, TRIP indication etc. as per drawing and specification.
LED indication lamp for the following- ON, OFF, TRIP (each for both the supplies)
LED phase indication lamp for R-Y-B.
Metering
Multifunction energy meter for measurement of voltage, line current, power factor, power & energy.
3 Nos. CTs 1000/5A, 15VA, CL-1 for metering.
1 Nos. CTs 1000/5A, 15VA, CL-1 for APFCR relay.
BUS BAR

Electrolytic high conductivity T P &N+E copper conductor bus-bars (as specified in the Specifications) rated 1250 Amps, suitable to withstand symetrical fault level of ~~56~~ 50KA for 1 second at 415 volts.
